title: H. A. Denton
text:
H. A. Denton

DENISON—Funeral services will be held Thursday at 2 p.m. in the Calvary Mission Baptist Church for H. A. Denton, 67, of Denison, who died Tuesday in a Wichita Falls hospital.

Rites will be conducted by Rev. Ernest Potter, with burial in Sunnyside Cemetery under direction of Earnheart Funeral Home of Whitewright.

Mr. Denton, a retired farmer, was born Jan. 24, 1890, in Savoy, a son of the late Joseph D. and Mary Jane Denton. He was married to Elizabeth Gaines in Savoy in 1949. He was a member of the Calvary Mission Baptist Church.

He is survived by his wife, two sons, H. A. Denton Jr. of Denison and Joe Denton of DeKalb; two daughters, Mrs. Ed Bullard of Sherman and Mrs. Julian Chrissman of Grand Prairie; one brother, Robert Bigbee of San Antonio and eleven grandchildren.
